changeSummary: Colour polish. Fixed a brightness-only tag forcing Smart Life bulbs to white mode and wiping the colour set elsewhere (e.g. Google Home); a brightness tap now moves only the value channel when the light is in colour mode. Added 22 spectrum colours plus a Whites tab with six white points and an 1800-6500 K temperature slider (stored as plain RGB, no new capability). Gradients deferred: needs segmented hardware not available to test.
codePathVerified: TuyaProvider.setBrightness reads work_mode: in colour mode it re-sends colour_data with the stored h/s and only a new v, and sends neither work_mode nor bright_value (LightCommandPayloadTest)
in white mode it sets bright_value and does not send work_mode
ColorMath.kelvinToRgb / nearestKelvin round-trip for the six generated white points; saturated hues are not misread as white (ColorPaletteTest)
no Room schema change; colorRgb already stores any 24-bit value, so tags from 0.0.5-0.0.9 are unaffected
notVerified: the two changes on real hardware this cycle (brightness-preserves-colour on a Smart Life lamp; the new palette and kelvin slider on a real bulb)
the exact rendered hue and level at the bulb
Tuya scenes (no scene subscription; the scene list is empty)
gradients / multi-colour effects (deferred; no segmented device available)
